biotools.summary: H2M is a computational pipeline that models human genetic variation in mice, providing a database of equivalent mutation pairs and resources for precision medicine applications. It integrates variant mapping analyses with genome editing pipelines and offers a user-oriented documentation and readily accessible installation pathways.
